events.title: 10,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: A day before Steam Next Fest, Funeral for the Sun managed to reach 10,000 wishlists! That's a big number.These milestones are super important when it comes to making sure that the game has a solid launch, so fingers cross that everything goes well. events.title: Funeral for the Sun Launches November 9!
events.summary: After more than a year of development, I'm happy to say that I'll be ready to release Funeral for the Sun this November 9th!For those that haven't been following the journey thus far, I'm Nico, the solo developer behind this magical realist detective game. Inspired by games like Return of the Obra Dinn, as well as Latin American fiction like 100 years of Solitude, I decided to make a game all about uncovering a mystery buried deep in the past of a small town nested deep in the jungle.Each memory

events.title: Funeral for the Sun will be localized to Simplified Chinese!
events.summary: Funeral for the Sun has received a lot of support from English speaking audiences during its release cycle, so I’m very happy to announce that it will be receiving a localization to simplified Chinese shortly after its initial English-only launch this fall! For now, you can keep track of the project by wishlisting the game on steam. A simplified chinese translation of this demo is expected to be released later this year.

events.title: Updated Demo for Thinky Direct and Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
events.summary: The biggest change is the new checklist sub-menu:Now players will be encouraged to find all memories in the demo and utilize their webs to deduce important details about the mysterious characters they find!Alongside this, I also added labels to each pencil so you always know exactly what each color line means!And finally, I added a separate 'hand tool' for the book, so that now every single action in the game can be taken with a simple left click!
